benchmarks.provenance: Benchmark: Glazer et al. 2024 (FrontierMath, Epoch AI), which reports state-of-the-art models under 2% at launch. o3 25.2% claimed in OpenAI's Dec 2024 announcement (high test-time compute, internal scaffold, 180-problem 2024-11-26 set). Independent evaluation of the released o3 by Epoch AI measured ~10% on the 290-problem 2025-02-28 set (reported by TechCrunch, Apr 2025); Epoch attributes the gap to compute settings, scaffold, and the changed problem set. OpenAI's funding of the benchmark was disclosed only after the announcement (TechCrunch, Jan 2025). All figures non-peer-reviewed.
